title: Apply a typed inventory event batch
statement: Apply inventory events from left to right, starting with no stock. Every quantity must be positive. stock adds quantity for its SKU. sale subtracts quantity, but rejects when the SKU has insufficient stock. Return the first rejection with its zero-based event index and SKU. On success return all balances; a sale that reaches zero keeps that SKU in the map with balance zero.
constraints: use the exact declared event and result types
return the first invalid event and do not throw or panic
inputs and resulting balances fit int64 and contain at most 10000 events
handle every event and result variant explicitly without catch-all or default branches
do not perform input/output, add tests, or suppress static diagnostics

jett.signature:
namespace benchmark

enum InventoryEvent:
    stock(sku: string, quantity: int64)
    sale(sku: string, quantity: int64)

enum InventoryResult:
    accepted(balances: map[string, int64])
    rejected(index: int64, sku: string)

function apply_inventory(events: list[InventoryEvent]) returns InventoryResult
